entries.summary: Bitnami moved its free versioned images out of docker.io/bitnami into docker.io/bitnamilegacy on 2025-08-28; the legacy copies are no longer updated
entries.detail: The announcement says only a limited set of hardened images stays in the Bitnami public catalogue, for development use, and that deletion of docker.io/bitnami was postponed to 2025-09-29. Linuxiac (2025-08-29) reports the remaining free images are under the latest tag only, in a bitnamisecure namespace, and that older versioned tags need a paid subscription.

entries.summary: docker.io/bitnamilegacy holds the images moved out of docker.io/bitnami on 2025-08-28; it gets no further updates or support and is meant for temporary migration only
upstream repo minio/minio archived on 2026-04-25; its README says the repository is no longer maintained
entries.detail: Linuxiac (2025-12-05) reports MinIO put the open-source project into maintenance-only mode and had stopped publishing Docker images in mid-October 2025. On 2026-11-03 hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/minio/minio returned 404.

entries.summary: Dockhand is licensed under BUSL-1.1, which the OSI has not approved; its licence terms were revised on 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-03
entries.detail: The first LICENSE.txt (2025-12-28) was already BUSL-1.1, with the change date fixed at 2029-01-01. The current file moves the change date to four years after each version is first released, and sets out free use and commercial licence terms.

entries.summary: HashiCorp changed the licence of vault from MPL-2.0 to BUSL-1.1 for releases from 1.15.0 on, announced 2023-08-10
entries.detail: The LICENSE file in hashicorp/vault names Vault version 1.15.0 or later as the licensed work under the Business Source License 1.1; the current licensor is IBM. Earlier releases stay under MPL-2.0.

entries.summary: MongoDB Community Server releases from 2018-10-16 on are under SSPL-1.0, which the OSI has not approved; earlier releases stay under AGPL-3.0
entries.detail: Per MongoDB's FAQ the SSPL also covers patch releases of older versions made on or after that date, so an old tag can be affected too.

CockroachDB moved to a single proprietary source-available licence, the CockroachDB Software License, on 2024-11-18 and retired the free Core edition
entries.detail: Cockroach Labs offers CockroachDB Enterprise Free for individuals and businesses under USD 10M in annual revenue. The licence requires a licence key to operate the software and requires telemetry for the free tier.
